create_VideoReader: create a VideoReader instance to load a video file with optional sampling rate and audio resampling
read_video_audio_frames: read video and audio frames from a video file starting at a given offset for a specified number of frames
seek_video_position: seek to a specific offset in a video stream with configurable backward and any_frame options
compute_video_statistics: compute video statistics including start PTS, time base, and total number of frames
read_entire_audio_stream: read all remaining audio frames from a video file starting at a given offset with optional resampling
